I've tried to insert console.log here https://github.com/webpack/webpack/blob/master/lib/SourceMapDevToolPlugin.js#L117

```
content == undefined && console.log(moduleFilenames[i], modules[i]);
```

and I get 

```
> webpack:/// undefined
```

@sokra I think that [this](https://github.com/webpack/webpack/blob/master/lib/ModuleFilenameHelpers.js#L50) check is also must be present here: 

https://github.com/webpack/webpack/blob/master/lib/ModuleFilenameHelpers.js#L96
